items.description: The Foumban bauxite deposits in the West Region are a potential source of alumina, currently being evaluated for industrial extraction.
Ngaoundal holds significant bauxite reserves in the Adamawa Region, positioned as a key asset for Cameroon's future aluminum industry.
The Camalco Makan bauxite project focuses on developing the high-quality mineral resources found in the Makan area of the Adamawa plateau.
The Royal Palace of Foumban is the seat of the Bamum Sultanate, showcasing the rich history and architecture of one of Cameroon's oldest kingdoms.
Bimbia was a major slave trading port on the coast of Cameroon, now serving as a somber memorial site for the transatlantic slave trade.
The Prime Minister's Lodge in Buea was the residence of the heads of government during the British Southern Cameroons colonial era.
The Bismarck Fountain in Buea is a relic of the German colonial period, named after the German Chancellor Otto von Bismarck.
The palace of Charles Atangana, the paramount chief of the Ewondo people, is a historic residence in Yaounde reflecting the colonial chiefdom era.
The Mankon Fon's Palace is a major cultural and historical center in Bamenda, serving as the traditional seat of the Mankon kingdom.
Notre-Dame-des-Victoires is a historic cathedral in Yaounde, serving as a spiritual center and a monument of religious history in the capital.
The Reunification Monument in Yaounde commemorates the 1961 union of French and British Cameroons into a single nation.
The Old German Cemetery in Douala contains the graves of German colonial officials and settlers from the late 19th and early 20th centuries.
The General Leclerc Monument in Douala honors the French commander who played a key role in the Free French movement during World War II.
The Lamidat of Banyo is a traditional Fulbe chiefdom in the Adamawa Region, preserving centuries-old administrative and cultural practices.
The Lamidat of Ngaoundere is one of the most powerful traditional sultanates in northern Cameroon, located in the heart of the Adamawa plateau.
